reviewer: root exact effective-design and bounded primary-source review
reason: The four f22r X+daiin cells and twelve H-head X-daiin triples do not establish a referent-preserving alias contrast. Different entries can share a class, while aliases can have different head/body profiles. No specific alias consequence beyond the repeated value template, or complete independent comparison pair outside f22r, is nominated.

design.contrast: apposition/alias of one referent versus separate material, part, or value-field entries
design.countermodel: A fixed recipe template can place independently typed fields adjacently and make them look appositional; repeated daiin may be a shared value slot without shared referent.
design.falsifier: In a held set with independent referent/class coding, parallel X+daiin cells consistently have distinct typed heads and no alias recurrence, falsifying the apposition variant.
design.mechanism: A repeated X+daiin construction can place an appositional alias or alternate label beside one referent, rather than introducing an independently typed entry for every neighboring X.
design.prediction: Under apposition, paired X+daiin cells should share an independently coded referent or class and show alias-like recurrence; under separate-entry analysis, the cells should occupy distinct typed field roles and recur with different head/body profiles.
design.principal_risk: No independent referent or class annotation may exist, and the apparent apposition can be produced by the same local field template.
design.related: Near GDT764 bounded H1-X-daiin field dispatch and GDT765's main-field/subfield renderer, but changes the discriminator to apposition versus separate entries rather than axis assignment or concrete noun selection.
design.scope_note: The source supplies working whole-form roles and no independent material gold; this is an exploratory construction question, not a claim that ofchy or schor is translated.

source_evidence.quote:
## The f22r record now says something

The first two lines of the local paragraph contain four exact value cells:

```text
f22r.4  ofchy daiin  ...  schor daiin
f22r.5  ol daiin     ...  dar daiin
```

Across the entire cache there are twelve exact `H-head X daiin` triples
(H1 five, H2 five, H4 two); f22r.4 alone contains two on one line. That makes a
main-field/subfield inventory much more natural than a sequence of actions.

design.unit: complete parallel X+daiin cells with independently coded head class, field position, and recurrence outside the motivating f22r lines
